methodology:
PT Sampoerna Agro operates ~158K hectares across Indonesia split between oil palm (majority) and sago palm (specialty). 3-row breakdown by region + crop type:
- Sumatra oil palm core (235K ac)
- Kalimantan oil palm (110K ac)
- Sago palm (46K ac) — SGRO is Indonesia's largest sago producer; Riau/South Sumatra Selat Panjang area

Sago marked at ~50% discount to mature palm per-acre to reflect specialty crop economics + smaller resale market. Total ~391K acres.
